02  Business of Connections — Partnership 2027
Our 2027 Conferences

Two specialist conferences. One European network.

Business of Class Actions Europe
Porto  |  19 February 2027

A one-day European conference focused on how collective actions work in practice. The programme will examine cross-border cases, qualified entities, settlements, economic evidence, litigation funding and emerging risks for companies.

Expected audience: 80+ participants
Business of Competition
Prague  |  April 2027

A two-day conference bringing together competition practitioners, economists, regulators, businesses and litigation funders for practical discussions of enforcement, private litigation, digital markets and their impact on business.

Expected audience: 80–100 participants
